name: Enhanced Surveillance
oracle_text:
You may look at an additional two cards each time you surveil.
Exile this enchantment: Shuffle your graveyard into your library.
blocked_sentences: You may look at an additional two cards each time you surveil.

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: "you") that modifies every surveil its controller performs, raising the number of cards looked at by a fixed addend (here +2) while the extra cards follow the same graveyard-or-top choice; optional ("you may"), so the player chooses each time whether to look at the extra cards
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has replace_draw, replace_mill, replace_proliferate and similar replacements but nothing that reads or changes a surveil; the surveil op takes only amount and player, so the change cannot be made at the card's own level, and a surveil trigger (itself a gap) would add a second surveil rather than enlarge the first
